name: Mistral AI
description: European model lab whose default Free (Experiment) plan gives rate-limited API access.
overview: Mistral's La Plateforme defaults new accounts to the Free (Experiment) plan, which serves the Mistral Small, Medium, Codestral and Ministral models at roughly one request per second with a per-model token-per-minute ceiling. Frontier entries in the same catalogue — Mistral Large 4 and the GLM routes — show up on the Limits page but are gated behind a paid plan. The plan uses your data for training unless you opt out in the admin panel, and signup needs phone verification.
free_access: Free (Experiment) plan is the default for new accounts
Per-model caps: 20K TPM on Small and Medium, 40K TPM on Codestral and Ministral
Frontier models such as Mistral Large 4 are listed but not served on the free plan
notes: The console's Limits page lists every model with free-mode caps, including Mistral Large 4 and GLM 5.3, but those routes answer only on a paid plan — request access per model before relying on them. Opt out of training in the Admin panel.
